Hi, I'm Anirudh. I’m an M1 Data Analytics and Pattern Classification (DATAPAC) student at Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris).
I’m interested in computer vision, explainability, and its applications in various domains like medical ML.

Currently, I'm working with [Prof. Gianni Franchi](https://giannifranchi.github.io/) on explainability in computer vision. Previously, I was lucky enough to work with [Prof. Dianbo Liu](https://www.cogai4sci.com/), National University of Singapore and [Prof. Min Xu](https://xulabs.github.io/), Carnegie Mellon University.

I'm always open to new opportunities collaborations, or just to say hi! You can reach me either via [email](mailto:apml2304@gmail.com) or any the links given.
